question: What is EWU's policy on cheating?
answer: EWU has a policy of zero tolerance on cheating [Page 218]. question: What are the requirements for the freedom fighter admission quota and tuition waiver?
answer:
The university reserves a 3% admission quota for the wards of freedom fighters of all categories, subject to their fulfillment of the minimum admission requirements at East West University [Page 223]. For children of freedom fighters, the minimum admission requirements include a total GPA of 5.00 in both SSC and HSC examinations, or at least one first division in either SSC or HSC (no third division is allowed) [Page 176].

The university considers a maximum 100% tuition waiver scholarship to the wards of wounded, deceased and financially needy freedom fighters, subject to the candidate qualifying in the EWU admission test and providing proof that their parent was a freedom fighter [Page 223]. To continue the tuition fee waiver, the student's CGPA must remain 2.60 or more in each semester [Page 223]. To continue financial aid, undergraduate students must register for at least three courses (9 credits) in each semester; for B.Pharm. students, this requirement is at least four courses (12 credits) [Page 223]. Financial aid is discontinued if a student violates the East West University Disciplinary Code for Students and/or if their CGPA falls below 2.60 calculated on the basis of the grades earned in the last three consecutive semesters/one year [Page 223].

answer: To graduate from the B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) undergraduate program, 140 credits are required [Page 24].
